notes: candidate code runs as uid 65534; the protected store is owned by uid 0 with mode 0700

what_is_enforced: Candidate code (validators and policies) executes under a separate operating-system user with Node's permission model on top; the protected rules, held-out cases, evaluation records and release registry are owned by the gate's user with mode 0700.
what_is_only_procedural: A live model worker acting as candidate author runs as the operator user in this build; whether `claude -p` can authenticate under the candidate uid was not verified.
The held-out generator is committed in this repository for reproducibility, so an author with repository read access as the operator user could read it.
The operator account (root here) can edit the protected store; that is detected by digest comparison, not prevented.
